xmldoc.short_description: Write a .proto file from a struct or a table.

param_input_item.param_description: a struct, a struct array or a table.
the message name ('Record' by default) and the package of the .proto file.

description.p: protobuf.infer writes a proto3 .proto file that describes a struct, a struct array or a table, to start a schema from data. Numbers give scalar fields (repeated when a value has several elements), text gives string, uint8 gives bytes, datetime and duration give Timestamp and Duration, and nested structs give nested messages. A field empty in some records is marked optional.
The text is a starting point to read and adjust, not a schema on its own; pass it to protobuf.load with 'Format', 'text' to use it.
